sentences.text: The largest known skull of this fish may have reached approximately 10 cm in length.
Quasipetalichthys haikouensis is the only known species of the extinct genus, and its fossils are found exclusively in the Haikou Formation, which is exposed in south-central China.
Quasipetalichthys belongs to the class Placodermi, a group of armored fish.
Quasipetalichthys is considered a basal member of the Petalichthyidae, though some researchers once called it aberrant.
Eurycaraspis is placed in the family Quasipetalichthyidae as a sister taxon to Quasipetalichthys.
Quasipetalichthys fossils were found alongside antiarch placoderms like Bothriolepis sinensis and Hunanolepis.
The presence of Devonian plants alongside placoderm fossils suggests Quasipetalichthys lived in a near-shore or freshwater environment.
